mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation, as measured by CPIAUCSL, indicates reduced real purchasing power and increased real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds Rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing risk appetite, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS rate increases (>0.2pp in 1 month) and UNRATE declines (>0.1pp in 1 month) signal an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.2pp in 1 month AND UNRATE decrease > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises >0.2pp and UNRATE falls >0.1pp in prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 2000 units signals a housing market contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 2000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 4.5% signals a tight labor market driving wage inflation and anticipated monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 100 (2017 baseline) signals an industrial production contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and increasing recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved economic outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous RSAFS increases (>0.5% in 1 month) and INDPRO increases (>0.3% in 1 month) signal strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 0.5% in 1 month AND INDPRO increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises >0.5% and INDPRO rises >0.3% in prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
